The Chinese characters for Omar

As a transliteration, Omar is usually written 奥马尔 (Ào mǎ ěr). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

From Arabic, Omar carries the meaning “flourishing, long-lived”.

About the name Omar

The second caliph of Islam, Omar ibn al-Khattab, bore this name.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Omar carries the meaning “flourishing, long-lived” and looks striking in brush strokes.
